title: GPARS Agent Capability Manifest
description: Machine-readable declaration of intended agent capabilities for a general-purpose agent.

id.description: Unique identifier for the agent within its operational domain.

capabilities.description: Declared classes of behavior the agent is designed to perform. Capability IDs are manifest-local references and do not carry global GPARS semantics.

extensions.description: Optional extension metadata. Keys SHOULD use reverse-domain notation to avoid collisions.

id.description: Manifest-local identifier for this declared agent capability.

description.description: Human-readable, non-authoritative description of what the agent is designed to do.
